reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend with a holidays parameter and threads it through every caller, but schedules/app.ts does not reuse the new isNonWorkingDay predicate.

duplication.why: The 'weekend or holiday' test is written as isNonWorkingDay in shared/schedules.ts and again inline twice in schedules/app.ts (getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange).

placement.why: Date adjustment stays in shared/schedules.ts where the weekend rule lives, but isNonWorkingDay is kept private so the server layer re-derives it.

scope.why: Focused on holidays; the small adjustWeekend closure in schedule-template.ts is a reasonable local tidy-up of a duplicated ternary.

maintainability.why: Changing what counts as a non-working day requires editing the shared predicate plus two inline copies in app.ts and the conditional in getNextDate.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange inline d.isWeekend(...) || config.holidays?.includes(...) instead of a shared isNonWorkingDay.

disguised_duplication.where: The isNonWorkingDay logic is reshaped as inline boolean expressions in schedules/app.ts and as a holidays ? isNonWorkingDay : isWeekend conditional in getNextDate.

one_place.where: Date moving is centralised in getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but the daily-skip rule for holidays is decided separately in getNextDate (shared/schedules.ts) and twice in server/schedules/app.ts.
